pr_title: Fix benchmark campaign self-pause on child startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- add an isolated benchmark-child AI Studio initialization path
- skip interactive campaign checkpoint recovery inside benchmark children
- keep normal Editor restart recovery unchanged

## Root cause

Each benchmark run starts a child `engine-editor.exe`. The child previously restored the global Running campaign checkpoint before benchmark-child configuration, wrote `pause.requested` as if the Editor had restarted, and caused the parent harness to stop with 0 recorded runs.
